items.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: So we played that Far East thing and Cootie says, “uh huh, that’s all.”

All you have to do is come over to the house and we’ll have a little party and we’ll have some Cornish hen, bring your family and your kids and all that and I’ll invite a few other people and I’m going to invite some musicians to play along with you.” And in the back of my mind I said she wants some free music for her party.
